crossRefs.note: Joseph found favor in his sight. He ministered to him, and Potiphar made him overseer over his house, and all that he…
He left all that he had in Joseph’s hand. He didn’t concern himself with anything, except for the food which he ate.…
After these things, his master’s wife set her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”
No one is greater in this house than I am, and he has not kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife.…
He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.
“Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I said indeed that your house and the house of your father should walk…
Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: The keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison. Whatever they did there, he was responsible for it.
translations.bsb: And the warden put all the prisoners under Joseph’s care, so that he was responsible for all that was done in the prison.
translations.kjv: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer
translations.asv: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.
